modules.module_title: Maintain safe and secure working environment

ensure that relevant safety boards/signs are placed on the shop floor for the safety of self and others
report any identified breaches in health, safety and security policies and procedures to the designated person

ensure recyclable, non-recyclable and hazardous wastes are segregated as per SOP
ensure proper mechanism is followed while collecting and disposing of non-recyclable, recyclable and reusable waste

modules.module_title: Manage preparatory activities for SPONGE IRON/ DRI operation

pcs.pc_description: obtain the required information and work completed in previous shift from logbook, discussions etc. and take handover from the previous shift operator by following organizational procedures
ensure availability of sufficient quantity of raw material (iron ore, coal and dolomite) required for smooth operations and achieving production target
ensure that team is checking the quality of raw materials
ensure that work area is clean and free of any obstacle or encumbrance
Check the condition of kiln if taken into shutdown for cooling, accretion to be broken
Ensure preparation and application of castable on to the refractory surface
Check for preheating of kiln
Feed the raw material into the kiln at right proportion with time and temperature
Check the condition of kiln if in operation for operating parameters, feeding, nature and proportion of raw material
Check the working conditions of Shell Air Tubes, back flow, Coal Injection System, accretion formation at various places
Check the drop test of raw materials to cross check the quantity of raw material fed into kiln
Check for the quality of Sponge Iron at time of taking charge
ensure that all safety measures, interlocks, alarms are working and in conformance with the safe operation kiln as per SOP
coordinate with other related departments such as raw material handling and quality departments
use appropriate Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) for safe working in work area
calculate the feed rate of raw materials – iron ore, coal, injection coal and dolomite
feed the appropriate quantity and proportion of raw material in kiln as per SOP/ Work Instruction (WI)
operate the kiln as per SOP/WI
Inject the coal from the discharge end
Maintain the process parameters, temperature in different zones, kiln pressure at inlet and outlet and C/fe ratio
Control the air flow from Central Burner and Shell Air Fans
Carry out Quick Response Thermocouple for temperature measurement as and when required
Check the shell temperature at different locations as and when required
Take the sample of sponge iron from the discharge cooler and send the sample for chemical composition for analysis to lab
analyse the chemical composition for FeM, FeT, percentage metallization and size
Analyse specific consumption of raw materials
Adjust the dolomite feeding based on sulphur level in sponge iron
Check and analyse char and temperature of sponge iron coming out of cooler
Check the fused material alongwith the product from the cooler
Analyse waste gas coming out kiln for temperature, composition and flow
Check introduction of air in after burning chamber/post combustion chamber
Evaluate power generation potential from waste gas
Check the chemical composition of waste gas from Electrostatic Precipitator (ESP)
